words.gloss: in the home of those who trusted them

literal: Than those who are dead, different they are not, surely, who in the home of those who trusted them, evil having done, conduct themselves.
translation: Those who act wickedly by violating the trust of those who confided in them are surely no different from the dead.
modern: தம்மை நம்பியவர்களுடைய இல்லத்தில் தீமை செய்து வாழ்பவர்கள், இறந்தவர்களை விட வேறுபட்டவர்கள் அல்லர்; அவர்கள் பிணத்திற்கு ஒப்பானவர்களே ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the severe moral degradation of violating another's trust. The word 'தெளிந்தார்' refers to those who have placed complete trust in a person, and 'இல்' refers to their home or wife. Anyone who enters such a household and commits the ultimate betrayal of desiring the wife is said to be 'விளிந்தாரின் வேறல்லர்'—no different from a dead person. Although they are physically alive, their complete loss of virtue and honor renders them equivalent to a corpse.
